title: The O.G. Polo
body: The one that started it all. The OG Polo is an update of Ashworth’s original signature style, rebuilt with a cotton-performance blend and contrast tipping. CT TECH Soft like cotton. Sharp like tech. CT TECH is built for the golfer who values comfort as much as performance. By blending ultra-fine Pima cotton yarns with technical polyester fibers, this fabric feels soft and breathable like your favorite tee but performs with the durability and function of modern activewear. It wicks moisture, resists odor, and offers UPF 50+ protection, all while maintaining a natural cotton hand feel that wears just as well off the course. Designed to hold its shape and require minimal maintenance, CT TECH is the kind of fabric that keeps you looking sharp and feeling at ease, whether you’re chasing birdies or chasing daylight.

title: Fairway Polo
body: The Fairway polo combines semi-dull poly yarn with spandex to achieve a classic, crisp stripe appearance. Enhanced with a special yarn process, it boasts a super soft hand feel and stretch comfort, catering perfectly to golfers seeking enduring quality and comfort on the course. AG TECH Engineered for performance. Built for the heat. AG TECH is our most technically advanced knit, developed for the player who demands peak performance from their wardrobe. Crafted from a refined blend of full dull polyester yarns and spandex, it delivers a soft, supple hand feel with a matte finish and built-in stretch. Lightweight and highly breathable, this fabric moves with you and keeps you cool when the game heats up. Moisture-wicking and antimicrobial properties work overtime to manage sweat and odor, while UPF 50+ sun protection and wrinkle-resistant construction make it a reliable go-to for long days on the course. Whether you’re walking 18 or grinding through a summer range session, AG TECH is made to keep you dry, focused, and comfortable from the first tee to the last putt.

title: LS Newport Supima Polo
body: A long-sleeve essential in soft Supima cotton interlock. The LS Newport Supima Polo features a tailored collar, two-button placket, and a tonal Golfman logo at the left chest for a clean, elevated layer.

title: Fully Fashioned Polo
body: A refined wool polo for cooler days. The Fully Fashioned Polo is knit from 12-gauge superwash wool with a fully fashioned collar, a two-button placket, and ribbed cuffs and hem for a tailored, comfortable finish.

title: Houndstooth Polo
body: A fresh take on a classic. This polo combines subtle pattern with technical performance offering lightweight breathability, stretch, and UPF protection all in one. body: A statement print polo built from a soft, stretch cotton jersey. The Starburst Polo features a 3-button placket and self-fabric tailored collar for a clean, elevated look with a little more energy.

title: Fully Fashioned V-Neck Sweater
body: A classic layering piece made modern. The Fully Fashioned V-Neck Sweater is knit from 12-gauge superwash wool with a ribbed V-neck and contrast-trimmed cuffs, offering warmth and polish for cooler rounds.

title: Walt 1/4 Zip
body: A textured jacquard 1/4 zip in soft cotton, finished with contrasting trim at the zipper, cuff, and hem for a clean, elevated layer on cooler days.

title: Aeroflex V-Neck Pullover
body: A modern take on an Ashworth Classic. The aeroflex V-Neck Pullover uses a soft shell, 4-way stretch fabric with a DWR finish to shrug off light weather while keeping your swing free, finished with a Golfman logo on the left chest.

title: Aeroflex Vest
body: A sleeveless layer built for movement. The Aeroflex Vest uses a soft shell, 4-way stretch fabric with a DWR finish to shrug off light weather while keeping your swing free, finished with a Golfman logo at the back yoke.

body: A versatile layering piece designed for comfort and mobility. title: 1987 Golfman Hoodie
body: Insanely soft! Made from cotton and polyester, with just enough stretch for comfort. Wear it to the gym, on the plane, and everywhere. Features the iconic Golfman logo above the kangaroo pocket. We recommend buying two because one will surely be permanently borrowed by your wife or son.

body: A tribute to the game’s most timeless symbol. The Golfman Walking Tee is crafted from soft, breathable cotton with a relaxed fit for all-day comfort. Finished with the iconic Golfman graphic at the chest, it’s a laid-back essential that nods to Ashworth’s heritage.

title: Wide Wale Cord Woven Label Patch Cap
body: Effortlessly vintage in texture and style, this wide wale corduroy cap features a bold shield-shaped woven Ashworth Golf Company patch with "Since 1987" detailing, an unstructured low-profile silhouette, and a leather buckle strap closure for a relaxed, heritage-inspired look.

title: Embossed Croc Golfman Belt
body: Bold by design. Featuring embossed croc leather and our signature Golfman plaque buckle, this belt is a nod to heritage style with a modern, statement-making edge. Finished with soft backing for comfort and wearability. To determine your men's belt size based on your most recent pants purchase: You should select the next highest even-sized belt. For example: If your pants size is 34", you should choose a 36" belt. If your pants size is 35", you should choose a 36" belt.

title: Cloth Weave with Embossed Croc Tabs
body: A textured cloth weave belt finished with embossed croc-leather tabs, adding a refined, tailored detail to any pair of trousers or shorts. To determine your men's belt size based on your most recent pants purchase: You should select the next highest even-sized belt. For example: If your pants size is 34", you should choose a 36" belt. If your pants size is 35", you should choose a 36" belt.

title: Trouper Stand Bag
body: The Trouper Stand Bag from Jones was designed with a versatile single or double strap. It features a five-way divider, seven pockets, and a large insulated cooler pocket that fits up to four cans. Fleece-lined valuables compartments and a sturdy stand system make it the perfect blend of function and reliability.

title: Heritage Players Series Golf Bag
body: Inspired by the simplicity of classic carry bags, the Heritage Players Series Golf Bag in Kodiak brings craftsmanship to the course. Designed for those who appreciate tradition as much as performance, it balances lightweight functionality with timeless appeal. Three pockets provide just the right amount of storage, while a reinforced inner liner stands up to the miles walked. An expanded mesh sleeve holds larger water bottles for longer rounds. A nod to the game’s golden era, made to last for seasons to come. • Dimensions: 7" x 7" x 36" • 3-way divider • 3 Pockets

title: Heritage Clubhouse Duffle
body: Built with the spirit of travel in mind. The Heritage Clubhouse Duffle is roomy, durable, and sophisticated. The kind of piece that carries stories along with your essentials. • Dimensions: 20" x 11" x 11" • 1 main compartment, 1 side pocket • Includes black shoulder strap

title: Heritage Classic Shoe Bag
body: For the player who values the details. The Heritage Classic Shoe Bag is made from deluxe vegan leather offering protection and polish in equal measure. Ventilated for breathability and built to last, it’s a quiet expression of quality that travels well.

title: The Ranger Shag Bag / Cooler
body: Keep your rangefinder within reach with the Jones Rangefinder Pouch. Designed to clip easily onto your Jones bag with a YKK carabiner, it keeps your gear protected and secure with a cinch-close top. Part of the new R-Series, it’s crafted from 100% recycled PET ripstop—an innovative, water-resistant material made from single-use plastic bottles. Built for durability and tested in the unpredictable Pacific Northwest, this pouch combines sustainability with performance.

title: Reserve Classic Tour RS
body: Engineered for tour-level speed and stability, the Clarino™ Trivela microfiber upper pairs with PMX Speed PLT and a waterproof, breathable membrane for locked-in comfort, while a PMXFoam midsole, PMXNITROGEN+ footbed, and TPU outsole with Fast Twist® Tour Flex Pro spikes deliver responsive cushioning and uncompromising traction from first tee to final putt.

title: X Tour Proto RS
body: Designed with Tour player input, the Tour Proto RS offers golfers a performance advantage in a Tour proven spiked solution.

title: Payntr X 002 F
body: An award-winning design that defines premium performance. The X 002 LE pairs luxury craftsmanship with tour-level innovation, featuring a full-grain leather upper and ARIAPRENE® tongue for unmatched comfort and breathability. Treated with NEVERWET™️ for superior water and stain resistance, it’s built to perform in any condition. A Dual Density PMX Foam™️ midsole and molded ORTHOLITE™️ footbed deliver responsive cushioning, while the graphite power plate enhances stability through every swing. Finished with a FAST FIT lace system for easy entry and precise adjustment, and a durable TPU outsole for lasting traction on and off the course.

title: Match Day SC
body: The spikeless counterpart to Jason Day’s tour-winning model, the Eighty Seven SC is engineered for peak performance. A CLARINO™️ Trivela microfiber upper provides lightweight support and flexibility, while a waterproof, breathable membrane keeps feet dry in all conditions. The ARIAPRENE® tongue and bootie construction ensure a secure, locked-in fit for maximum stability. Underfoot, PMXNitro+ cushioning delivers responsive comfort and energy return, powered by a CARBITEX GearFlex™️ propulsion plate for explosive ground force. Finished with a durable 3D-traction TPU outsole built for lasting grip and performance on every swing.
